# Cedar Lane Ventures Fund II, L.P. — Q3 2025 Letter to Limited Partners
*Quarter ended September 30, 2025 | 2021 vintage, $120.0M in commitments*

Dear Limited Partners,

## 1. Summary
Fund II ended Q3 with $78.0M of paid-in capital, $9.6M in cumulative distributions, and a net asset value (NAV) of $86.4M. That is a TVPI of **1.23x, down from 1.33x last quarter**.

The decline reflects two impairments partially offset by one priced-round uplift, all applied under our valuation policy. The fund remains fully invested with no cash at quarter-end.

## 2. Fund performance
All figures in $M. Multiples rounded to two decimals.

|  | Jun 30, 2025 | Sep 30, 2025 |
|---|---|---|
| Paid-in capital | 78.0 | 78.0 |
| Cumulative distributions | 9.6 | 9.6 |
| NAV (unaudited fair value) | 94.5 | 86.4 |
| TVPI | 1.33x | 1.23x |
| DPI | 0.12x | 0.12x |
| RVPI | 1.21x | 1.11x |

Formulas:
* TVPI = (NAV + Cumulative Distributions) / Paid-in Capital
* DPI = Cumulative Distributions / Paid-in Capital
* RVPI = NAV / Paid-in Capital

Cumulative distributions of $9.6M are entirely from Ione Systems, exited in 2024 at a gain to its $3.0M cost. Cumulative management fees and fund expenses to date are $6.0M and are included in paid-in capital. Paid-in capital was unchanged in Q3.

## 3. Portfolio update
Marks are Sep 30, 2025 fair value in $M:

* **Arbor Pay — $30.0 (cost $12.0):** No material change in the quarter; mark held steady.
* **Brine Robotics — $4.5 (cost $9.0):** Missed operating plan and raised an insider bridge at a 50% discount to the last round; marked down accordingly.
* **Clearpath Bio — $0.4 (cost $8.0):** Board approved a wind-down on August 14; marked to our $0.4M estimated cash recovery.
* **Dovetail AI — $6.0 (cost $6.0):** New investors purchased SAFEs referencing a $150M cap, with no priced round; held at cost per policy.
* **Ember Grid — $14.0 (cost $10.0):** No material change; mark held steady.
* **Fathom Labs — $10.5 (cost $7.0):** No material change; mark held steady.
* **Gild Insurance — $12.0 (cost $8.0):** Closed a Series B priced round led by a new, unaffiliated investor at 1.5x our entry price; marked up to the round price.
* **Harrow — $9.0 (cost $9.0):** No material change; held at cost.

## 4. Write-downs and notable changes, told plainly
NAV fell $8.1M in the quarter. Two positions drove it:

* Clearpath Bio is winding down. We do not expect recovery beyond $0.4M, so we wrote the $8.0M June mark down by $7.6M.
* Brine Robotics missed plan and needed emergency funding at half the prior price. We cut the mark from $9.0M to $4.5M.

That was partly offset by Gild Insurance, where an outside-led priced round supported an increase from $8.0M to $12.0M. We did not mark up Dovetail AI despite positive interest, because an unpriced SAFE alone does not establish fair value.

## 5. Upcoming capital call
A $3.0M capital call was noticed on September 26 with a due date of October 15, 2025. It is **not** included in Q3 paid-in capital or multiples. Upon funding, paid-in capital will be $81.0M, or 67.5% of commitments.

## 6. Outlook
It was a difficult quarter on paper, with one wind-down and one interim down-valuation. Those losses are now reflected. Our focus is on supporting the leaders — Arbor Pay, Ember Grid, Fathom Labs, and newly-validated Gild — while managing Brine closely and maximizing the small Clearpath recovery. We continue to apply a consistent, evidence-based valuation approach and will keep you updated.

Thank you for your partnership.

Sincerely,  
Chief Financial Officer  
Cedar Lane Ventures

---
**Internal note to John Doe — do not send to LPs (86 words):**

John — corrections before send:
1. Paid-in $81.0M → $78.0M: Sep 26 $3M call due Oct 15 not paid by Sep 30, excluded.
2. TVPI 1.43x → 1.23x; “up” → down from 1.33x at Jun 30.
3. Clearpath $8.0M → $0.4M: Aug 14 wind-down requires impairment to estimated recovery.
4. Dovetail $18M → $6.0M: SAFE cap without priced round cannot support write-up per policy.
5. Retained Brine $4.5M (discount bridge = impairment) and Gild $12M (new-investor priced Series B supports markup). NAV is $86.4M, not $106M.
